description: This file defines an abstract class GammaBase that provides statistical gamma distribution functions, including calculation of the gamma and incomplete gamma functions, their inverses, and the log gamma function, as part of a spreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: GammaBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing gamma distribution functions used in statistical calculations, including methods for incomplete gamma, gamma value, and log gamma functions.

methods.name: calculateDistribution
methods.description: Computes the value of the gamma distribution, either cumulative or probability density, based on parameters.

methods.name: calculateInverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the gamma distribution's cumulative function, returning the value corresponding to a given probability.

methods.name: incompleteGamma
methods.description: Calculates the incomplete gamma function for given parameters.

methods.name: gammaValue
methods.description: Calculates the gamma function value for a given input.

methods.name: logGamma
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the gamma function for a given value.
